title: Ziyarat of Imam Ali Ridha
urduTitle: زیارت امام علی رضا علیہ السلام
intro: The visitation of Imam Ali al-Ridha at Mashhad, with the recitation and associated supplications in the selected source edition.
description: Read Ziyarat of Imam Ali Ridha with arabic text, transliteration and english meaning, recitation context and source references.

blocks.text:
Merits & All 8 forms of Ziyarats of Imam Ridha (as) click here

First Form of Ziyarat

This form of ziyarah, according to Shaykh al-Saduq’s book of man-la-yahduruhul-faqih, is as follows:

You may put on the purest and cleanest of your clothes, walk barefooted with tranquility and submission, and mention Almighty Allah in your heart, repeating the following :

blocks.english: Allah is the Most Great.
There is no god save Allah.
All glory be to Allah.
All praise be to Allah.

blocks.text: While entering the sacred shrine, you may say the following words:

blocks.english: In the Name of Allah (I begin), in Allah (I trust),
and the course of Allah’s Messenger (I follow),
peace be upon him and his Household.

blocks.arabic: أَشْهَدُ أَنْ لاَ إِلٰهَ إِلاَّ ٱللَّهُ
blocks.transliteration: ashhadu an la ilaha illa allahu
blocks.english: I bear witness that there is no god save Allah,
One and Only God and having no partner.

blocks.transliteration: wa ashhadu anna muhammadan `abduhu wa rasuluhu
blocks.english: And I bear witness that Muhammad is His servant and Messenger
and `Ali is Allah’s most intimate servant.

blocks.text: You may then walk towards the tomb to stop there, face it, and say the following words:

blocks.arabic: أَشْهَدُ أَنْ لاَ إِلٰهَ إِلاَّ ٱللَّهُ
blocks.transliteration: ashhadu an la ilaha illa allahu
blocks.english: I bear witness that there is no god save Allah,
One and Only God and having no partner.

blocks.transliteration: wa ashhadu anna muhammadan `abduhu wa rasuluhu
blocks.english: And I bear witness that Muhammad is His servant and Messenger,
the chief of the past and the coming generations,
and the chief of the Prophets and Messengers.
O Allah, (please) bless Muhammad,
Your servant, messenger, prophet,
and the chief of all Your creatures,

blocks.arabic: صَلاَةً لاَ يَقْوَىٰ عَلَىٰ إِحْصَائِهَا غَيْرُكَ
blocks.english: with such blessings that none can calculate save You.
O Allah, (please) bless the Commander of the Faithful
`Ali the son of Abi-Talib,
Your servant and the brother of Your Messenger,
whom You have selected on the basis of Your knowledge

blocks.arabic: وَجَعَلْتَهُ هَادِياً لِمَنْ شِئْتَ مِنْ خَلْقِكَ
blocks.transliteration: wa ja`altahu hadiyan liman shi'ta min khalqika
blocks.english: and thus made lead (to the truth) whomever You willed amongst Your creatures
and made the guide to those whom You sent with Your messages,
the establisher of the true religion owing to Your justice,
the decisive judge among Your creatures,
and the prevalent over all that.

blocks.transliteration: wa alssalamu `alayhi wa rahmatu allahi wa barakatuhu
blocks.english: Peace and Allah’s mercy and blessings be upon him.
O Allah, (please) send blessings on Fatimah
the daughter of Your Prophet,
the wife of Your friend,
the mother of the two grandsons al-Hasan and al-Husayn
the two chiefs of the youth of Paradise;
(she is) the genuinely pure, the immaculate, the purified,
the pious, the perfect, the pleased, the pristine,
and the doyenne of all the women of Paradise,

blocks.arabic: صَلاَةً لاَ يَقْوَىٰ عَلَىٰ إِحْصَائِهَا غَيْرُكَ
blocks.english: (bless her) with such blessings that none can count except You.
O Allah, (please) send blessings upon al-Hasan and al-Husayn,
the two grandsons of Your Prophet,
the two chiefs of the youth of Paradise,
the two who establish authority among Your creatures,
who guide to those whom You sent with Your messages,
who manage the religious affairs on the basis of Your justice,
and who judge on the basis of Your decrees among Your creatures.

blocks.arabic: اَللَّهُمَّ صَلِّ عَلَىٰ عَلِيِّ بْنِ ٱلْحُسَيْنِ
blocks.english: O Allah, (please) send blessings upon `Ali the son of al-Husayn,
Your servant who undertakes Your mission among Your creatures,
who guides to those whom You sent with Your messages,
who manages the religious affairs on the basis of Your justice,
who judges according to Your decrees among Your creatures,
and who is the prime of all worshippers.

blocks.arabic: اَللَّهُمَّ صَلِّ عَلَىٰ مُحَمَّدِ بْنِ عَلِيٍّ
blocks.english: O Allah, (please) send blessings on Muhammad the son of `Ali,
Your servant and Your representative in Your lands,
who split asunder the knowledge of the Prophets.

blocks.arabic: اَللَّهُمَّ صَلِّ عَلَىٰ جَعْفَرِ بْنِ مُحَمَّدٍ ٱلصَّادِقِ
blocks.transliteration: allahumma salli `ala ja`fari bni muhammadin alssadiqi
blocks.english: O Allah, (please) send blessings upon Ja`far the son of Muhammad,
Your servant, the authority of Your religion,
Your argument against all of Your creatures,
the veracious, and the dutiful.

blocks.arabic: اَللَّهُمَّ صَلِّ عَلَىٰ مُوسَىٰ بْنِ جَعْفَرٍ
blocks.english: O Allah, (please) send blessings upon Musa the son of Ja`far,
Your righteous servant,
Your spokesman among Your creatures,
who speaks with Your judgment,
and who is the argument against Your created beings.

blocks.arabic: اَللَّهُمَّ صَلِّ عَلَىٰ عَليِّ بْنِ مُوسَىٰ
blocks.english: O Allah, (please) send blessings upon `Ali the son of Musa,
the cordial, the well-pleased,
the servant of You, the authority of Your religion,
who undertakes the mission with Your justice,

blocks.arabic: وَٱلدَّاعِي إِلَىٰ دِينِكَ وَدِينِ آبَائِهِ ٱلصَّادِقِينَ
blocks.transliteration: waldda`i ila dinika wa dini aba'ihi alssadiqina
blocks.english: who calls to the religion of You and of his veracious fathers;

blocks.arabic: صَلاَةً لاََ يَقْوَىٰ عَلَىٰ إِحْصَائِهَا غَيْرُكَ
blocks.english: (bless him) with such blessings that none can count except You.

blocks.arabic: اَللَّهُمَّ صَلِّ عَلَىٰ مُحَمَّدِ بْنِ عَلِيٍّ
blocks.english: O Allah, (please) send blessings upon Muhammad the son of `Ali,
Your servant, Your authority,
who undertakes the mission by Your command
and calls to Your path.

blocks.arabic: اَللَّهُمَّ صَلِّ عَلَىٰ عَليِّ بْنِ مُحَمَّدٍ
blocks.english: O Allah, (please) send blessing upon `Ali the son of Muhammad,
Your servant and the authority of Your religion.

blocks.arabic: اَللَّهُمَّ صَلِّ عَلَىٰ ٱلْحَسَنِ بْنِ عَلِيٍّ
blocks.english: O Allah, (please) send blessings upon al-Hasan the son of `Ali
who carries out Your commands,
who undertakes the mission among Your creatures,
Your argument who acts on behalf of Your Prophet,
Your witness on Your creatures,
the exclusively endued with Your honor,

blocks.transliteration: aldda`i ila ta`atika wa ta`ati rasulika
blocks.english: and the caller to the obedience to You and to Your Messenger.
Your blessings be upon them all.
O Allah, (please) send blessings upon Your argument and authority
who undertakes the mission among Your creatures
with such blessing that is perfect, ever-increasing, and everlasting
due to which You may hasten his Relief,
grant him victory,

blocks.transliteration: wa taj`aluna ma`ahu fi alddunya wal-akhirati
blocks.english: and include us with him in this world and the Hereafter.
O Allah, I am seeking nearness to You through bearing love for them,
and I am loyal to their loyalists and enemy of their enemies.
So (please) provide me in their names the goodness of this world and the Hereafter

blocks.arabic: وَٱصْرِفْ عَنِّي بِهِمْ شَرَّ ٱلدُّنْيَا وَٱلآخِرَةِ
blocks.english: and fend off from me the evils of this world and the Hereafter
as well as the horrors of the Resurrection Day.

blocks.text: You may then sit to the side of the Imam’s head and say the following words:

blocks.english: Peace be upon you, O Allah’s friend.
Peace be upon you, O Allah’s argument.

blocks.arabic: اَلسَّلاَمُ عَلَيْكَ يَا نُورَ ٱللَّهِ فِي ظُلُمَاتِ ٱلأَرْضِ
blocks.transliteration: alssalamu `alayka ya nura allahi fi zulumati al-ardi
blocks.english: Peace be upon you, O Allah’s light in the darkness of the earth.
Peace be upon you, O pillar of the religion.

blocks.arabic: اَلسَّلاَمُ عَلَيْكَ يَا وَارِثَ آدَمَ صَفْوَةِ ٱللَّهِ
blocks.transliteration: alssalamu `alayka ya waritha adama safwati allahi
blocks.english: Peace be upon you, O inheritor of Adam the choice of Allah.

blocks.arabic: اَلسَّلاَمُ عَلَيْكَ يَا وَارِثَ نُوحٍ نَبِيِّ ٱللَّهِ
blocks.transliteration: alssalamu `alayka ya waritha nuhin nabiyyi allahi
blocks.english: Peace be upon you, O inheritor of Noah the prophet of Allah.

blocks.arabic: اَلسَّلاَمُ عَلَيْكَ يَا وَارِثَ إِبْرَاهِيمَ خَلِيلِ ٱللَّهِ
blocks.transliteration: alssalamu `alayka ya waritha ibrahima khalili allahi
blocks.english: Peace be upon you, O inheritor of Abraham the intimate friend of Allah.

blocks.arabic: اَلسَّلاَمُ عَلَيْكَ يَا وَارِثَ إِسْمَاعيلَ ذَبيحِ ٱللَّهِ
blocks.transliteration: alssalamu `alayka ya waritha isma`ila dhabihi allahi
blocks.english: Peace be upon you, O inheritor of Ishmael the slain for the sake of Allah.

blocks.arabic: اَلسَّلاَمُ عَلَيْكَ يَا وَارِثَ مُوسَىٰ كَلِيمِ ٱللَّهِ
blocks.transliteration: alssalamu `alayka ya waritha musa kalimi allahi
blocks.english: Peace be upon you, O inheritor of Moses the spoken by Allah.

blocks.arabic: اَلسَّلاَمُ عَلَيْكَ يَا وَارِثَ عِيسَىٰ رُوحِ ٱللَّهِ
blocks.english: Peace be upon you, O inheritor of Jesus the spirit of Allah.

blocks.arabic: اَلسَّلاَمُ عَلَيْكَ يَا وَارِثَ مُحَمَّدٍ رَسُولِ ٱللَّهِ
blocks.transliteration: alssalamu `alayka ya waritha muhammadin rasuli allahi
blocks.english: Peace be upon you, O inheritor of Muhammad the messenger of Allah.

blocks.arabic: اَلسَّلاَمُ عَلَيْكَ يَا وَارِثَ أَمِيرِ ٱلْمُؤْمِنِينَ
blocks.english: Peace be upon you, O inheritor of the Commander of the Faithful
`Ali the authority of Allah
and the successor of the Messenger of the Lord of the worlds.

blocks.arabic: اَلسَّلاَمُ عَلَيْكَ يَا وَارِثَ فَاطِمَةَ ٱلزَّهْرَاءِ
blocks.english: Peace be upon you, O inheritor of Fatimah the luminous lady.

blocks.arabic: اَلسَّلاَمُ عَلَيْكَ يَا وَارِثَ ٱلْحَسَنِ وَٱلْحُسَيْنِ
blocks.english: Peace be upon you, O inheritor of al-Hasan and al-Husayn
the two chiefs of the youth of Paradise.

blocks.arabic: اَلسَّلاَمُ عَلَيْكَ يَا وَارِثَ عَليِّ بْنِ ٱلْحُسَيْنِ زَيْنِ ٱلْعَابِدِينَ
blocks.transliteration: alssalamu `alayka ya waritha `aliyyi bni alhusayni zayni al`abidina
blocks.english: Peace be upon you, O inheritor of `Ali the son of al-Husayn the adornment of the worshippers.

blocks.arabic: اَلسَّلاَمُ عَلَيْكَ يَا وَارِثَ مُحَمَّدِ بْنِ عَلِيٍّ
blocks.english: Peace be upon you, O inheritor of Muhammad the son of `Ali
the splitter of the knowledge of the past and the last generations.

blocks.arabic: اَلسَّلاَمُ عَلَيْكَ يَا وَارِثَ جَعْفَرِ بْنِ مُحَمَّدٍ
blocks.transliteration: alssalamu `alayka ya waritha ja`fari bni muhammadin
blocks.english: Peace be upon you, O inheritor of Ja`far the son of Muhammad
the veracious and dutiful.

blocks.arabic: اَلسَّلاَمُ عَلَيْكَ يَا وَارِثَ مُوسَىٰ بْنِ جَعْفَرٍ
blocks.transliteration: alssalamu `alayka ya waritha musa bni ja`farin
blocks.english: Peace be upon you, O inheritor of Musa the son of Ja`far.
Peace be upon you, O ever-truthful and martyr.

blocks.arabic: اَلسَّلاَمُ عَلَيْكَ أَيُّهَا ٱلْوَصِيُّ ٱلْبَارُّ ٱلتَّقِيُّ
blocks.english: Peace be upon you, O dutiful and pious successor.
I bear witness that you performed the prayers,
defrayed the poor-rate (and alms),
enjoined the right,
forbade the wrong,

blocks.arabic: وَعَبَدْتَ ٱللَّهَ مُخْلِصاً حَتَّىٰ أَتَاكَ ٱلْيَقِينُ
blocks.transliteration: wa `abadta allaha mukhlisan hatta ataka alyaqinu
blocks.english: and serve Allah sincerely until death came upon you.
Peace be upon you, O Abu’l-Hasan.
Allah’s mercy and blessings be upon you.

blocks.text: You may then throw yourself on the tomb and say the following supplicatory prayer:

blocks.english: O Allah, for Your sake alone have I set out from my homeland
and covered many countries in the hope of winning Your mercy;

blocks.arabic: فَلاَ تُخَيِّبْنِي وَلاَ تَرُدَّنِي بِغَيْرِ قَضَاءِ حَاجَتِي
blocks.transliteration: fala tukhayyibni wa la taruddani bighayri qada'i hajati
blocks.english: so, (please) do not disappoint me and do not make me return without having my needs settled (by You),

blocks.arabic: وَٱرْحَمْ تَقَلُّبِي عَلَىٰ قَبْرِ ٱبْنِ أَخِي رَسُولِكَ
blocks.transliteration: warham taqallubi `ala qabri ibni akhi rasulika
blocks.english: and have mercy upon my turning over on the tomb of the son of Your Prophet’ brother,
Your blessings be upon him and his Household.

blocks.transliteration: bi'abi anta wa ummi ya mawlaya
blocks.english: May my father and mother be ransoms for you, O my master.
I have come to you visiting and getting to you,
seeking protection against all that which I have committed against myself
and overburdened my back with.
So, (please) be my intercessor with Allah
on the day of my poverty and neediness,
for you enjoy with Allah a praiseworthy position
and you are worthy of regard with Him.

blocks.text: You may then raise your right hand towards the sky, stretch out your left hand on the tomb, and say the following supplicatory prayer:

blocks.arabic: اَللَّهُمَّ إِنِّي أَتَقَرَّبُ إِلَيْكَ بِحُبِّهِمْ وَبِوِلاَيَتِهِمْ
blocks.transliteration: allahumma inni ataqarrabu ilayka bihubbihim wa biwilayatihim
blocks.english: O Allah, I do seek nearness to You through bearing love for them and being loyal to them;

blocks.arabic: أَتَوَلَّىٰ آخِرَهُمْ بِمَا تَوَلَّيْتُ بِهِ أَوَّلَهُمْ
blocks.transliteration: atawalla akhirahum bima tawallaytu bihi awwalahum
blocks.english: I am loyal to the last of them in the same way as I am loyal to the first

blocks.transliteration: wa abra'u min kulli walijatin dunahum
blocks.english: and I repudiate any adherence to any one other than them.
O Allah, pour curses on those who have altered Your bounty,
suspected Your Prophet,
denied Your signs,
scoffed at Your Imam,

blocks.arabic: وَحَمَلُوٱ ٱلنَّاسَ عَلَىٰ أَكْتَافِ آلِ مُحَمَّدٍ
blocks.transliteration: wa hamalu alnnasa `ala aktafi ali muhammadin
blocks.english: and placed the burden of the people upon the shoulders of Muhammad’s Household.

blocks.arabic: اَللَّهُمَّ إِنِّي أَتَقَرَّبُ إِلَيْكَ بِٱلْلَّعْنَةِ عَلَيْهِمْ
blocks.english: O Allah, I do seek nearness to You through invoking curse on these peoples (i.e. the enemies of the Holy Prophet’s Household)

blocks.arabic: وَٱلْبَرَاءَةِ مِنْهُمْ فِي ٱلدُّنْيَا وَٱلآخِرَةِ يَا رَحْمٰنُ
blocks.transliteration: walbara'ati minhum fi alddunya wal-akhirati ya rahmanu
blocks.english: and disavowing them in this world and the Hereafter, O All-beneficent Lord.

blocks.text: You may turn to the side of the Imam’s feet and say the following words:

blocks.arabic: صَلَّىٰ ٱللَّهُ عَلَيْكَ يَا أَبَا ٱلْحَسَنِ
blocks.english: Allah’s blessings be upon you, O Abu’l-Hasan.
Allah’s blessings be upon your soul and body.
You did act patiently and you are veracious and believed.

blocks.arabic: قَتَلَ ٱللَّهُ مَنْ قَتَلَكَ بِٱلأَيْدِي وَٱلأَلْسُنِ
blocks.transliteration: qatala allahu man qatalaka bil-aydi wal-alsuni
blocks.english: May Allah kill those who killed you with hands and tongues.

blocks.text:
Then supplicate fervently pronouncing la'nah (anathema) on the killers of Ameerul Momineen, Imam Hasan, Imam Hussain (peace be upon them) and those who shed the blood of the family of the Prophet (peace and blessings upon him and his family).

It is worth mentioning that invocation of Almighty Allah’s curse on the enemies of the Holy Imams can be said in any language or form. However, the most appropriate form may be the following, which is quoted from some validly reported supplications:

blocks.english: O Allah, pour curses on the slayers of the Commander of the Faithful,
the slayers of al-Hasan and al-Husayn, peace be upon them,
and the slayers of the members of Your Prophet’s Household.

blocks.arabic: اَللَّهُمَّ ٱلْعَنْ أَعْدَاءَ آلِ مُحَمَّدٍ وَقَتَلَتَهُمْ
blocks.transliteration: allahumma il`an a`da'a ali muhammadin wa qatalatahum
blocks.english: O Allah, curse the enemies and slayers of Muhammad’s family members,
add up chastisement to the chastisement that You decide for them,
add up humility to the humility that You decide for them,
add up disgrace to the disgrace that You decide for them,
and add up ignominy to the ignominy that You decide for them.
O Allah, thrust them into Hellfire with disdainful thrusting,
cast them down in the painful torment of You with violent casting,

blocks.transliteration: wahshurhm wa atba`ahum ila jahannama zumaran
blocks.english: and drive them and their followers to Hell in groups.

blocks.text:
You may then return to the side of the Imam’s head and offer a two-unit prayer in which you may recite Surah Yasin (No. 36) after Surah al-Fatihah in one unit and Surah al-Rahman (No. 55) after Surah al-Fatihah in the other.

You may also pray and implore Almighty Allah as earnestly as possible.

You may also pray for yourself, your parents, and your brothers and sisters-in-faith as much as you can.

You may stay at the side of the Imam’s head as long as you wish, offering all your prayers there

8) Supplication After Salaat of Ziyaarat of Imam Reza (a.s.) on 25th Zilqad from Far Sahifa Radhvia

blocks.arabic: اَللّٰهُمَّ اِنَّ ہَاتَیْنِ الرَّكْعَتَیْنِ ہَدِیَّۃٌ مِنِّیْ اِلٰی رُوْحِ سَیِّدِیْ وَ اِمَامِیْ عَبْدِكَ وَ وَلِیِّكَ اَبِیْ الْحَسَنِ عَلِیِّ بْنِ مُوْسَی الرِّضَا صَلَوَاتُكَ وَ تَسْلِیْمَاتُكَ عَلٰی رُوْحِہٖ وَ جَسَدِہٖ.
blocks.transliteration: allaahumma inna haataynir rak-a’tayne hadiyyatun minnee elaa roohe sayyedee wa emaamee a’bdeka wa waliyyeka abil hasane a’liyy ibne moosar rezaa salawaatoka wa tasleemaatoka a’laa roohehi wa jasadehi
blocks.english: O Allah! These two units of prayer are present from me to the soul of my master and my Imam, Your servant and Your vicegerent, Abu al-Hasan Ali Ibn Moosa al-Reza, Your blessings and Your peace be upon his soul and his body.

blocks.arabic: اَللّٰہُمَّ فَبَلِّغْہُمَا مِنِّیْ اِلٰی رُوْحِہٖ وَ ارْدُدْ عَلَیَّ مِنْ رُوْحِہِ التَّحِیَّۃَ وَ السَّلَامَ.
blocks.transliteration: allaahumma fa-ballighomaa minnee elaa roohehi war dud a’layya min roohehit tahiyyata was salaam.
blocks.english: O Allah! Convey to the soul of both of them two from me and and convey to me from his soul greetings and salutations.

blocks.arabic: اَللّٰہُمَّ وَاجْزِنِیْ عَلٰی ذٰلِكَ اَفْضَلَ الْجَزَآءِ مِنْكَ وَ فِیْ رَسُوْلِكَ وَ فِیْ وُلْدِ رَسُوْلِكَ وَ فِیْ وَلِیِّكَ وَ فِیْ وُلْدِ وَلِیِّكَ یَا وَلِیَّ الْمُؤْمِنِیْنَ.
blocks.transliteration: allaahumma waj zenee a’laa zaaleka afzalal ja-zaaa-e minka wa fee rasooleka wa fee wulde rasooleka wa fee waliyyeka wa fee wulde waliyyeka yaa waliyyal moameneen.
blocks.english: O Allah! And reward me for it with the best of the reward from You, and from Your Prophet, and from the sons of Your Prophet, and from Your vicegerent, and from the sons of Your vicegerent, O the authority of the believers!0

urduGuidance: یہ صفحہ زیارت امام علی رضا علیہ السلام کے لیے ہے۔ عربی متن اصل قراءت کے لیے ہے اور رومن تلفظ پڑھنے میں مدد دیتا ہے۔ انگریزی معنی الگ درج ہیں۔ ماخذ اور دوسری زیارات کے روابط صفحے کے آخر میں دیے گئے ہیں۔
